message: No detected input validation: The code directly consumes request JSON and passes it to downstream functions without any schema validation, type checks, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: URLs from user-supplied data are passed directly to the ReviewScraper without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks on the fetched content.

No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions for anomalies, or uses a label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples; it only checks dataset size (< 1000 rows) before proceeding.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle to serialize/deserialize models but performs no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision checks before loading serialized model files.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses SMOTE for oversampling imbalanced classes but does not perform any explicit label distribution validation, class balance check, or expected-label-set check before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or anomaly detection on training gradients anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing tools or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While sklearn train_test_split is used, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., signed/hashed test sets), no multiple independent evaluators, and metrics are computed and logged without any tamper-protection mechanism.

No detected input sanitization: Incoming request data is deserialized with `await request.json()` and passed directly to the organizer or SentimentAnalysis classes without any schema validation, type checks, or field presence guards.

No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and sentiment results are converted to strings and returned directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the model output.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The /checksentiment endpoint passes user-supplied text straight into the sentiment analysis model with only a basic string split, with no input filtering, content moderation, or injection detection.
